summary: Evaluate synchronous ESM dependencies before the importer using module-graph traversal, not C# textual execution.

target.notes: Recursively evaluate requested modules, handle cycles, then execute the importer; top-level await is delegated to the existing ASYNC rule.

semantics.ordering: dependencies before importer for synchronous graph

caveats: Top-level await changes scheduling and is already covered by async.top-level-await.

tests.name: independent requests follow source order
tests.expected_behavior: prints a then b then main
